description: This file contains functions to create audit logs for the LiteLLM Proxy, including creating logs for object updates and internal user actions. It interacts with database clients and secret management to conditionally record audit entries.

methods.name: create_object_audit_log( object_id: str, action: AUDIT_ACTIONS, litellm_changed_by: Optional[str], user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, litellm_proxy_admin_name: Optional[str], table_name: LitellmTableNames, before_value: Optional[str] = None, after_value: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Creates an audit log for an internal user action, recording the change made to an object, with optional before and after values. It checks configuration flags before proceeding.

methods.name: create_audit_log_for_update(request_data: LiteLLM_AuditLogs)
methods.description: Creates an audit log entry for a specific object update request, checking user privileges, configuration, and database connectivity before inserting the log into the database.
